violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. The white vertical panel on the inside of the ice machine bin was visibly soiled and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Clean this portion of the ice machine as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed a glue-board style flying insect trapping device that was completely full of dead flies near the mopsink area
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. Please remove the insect trapping device as soon as possible before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over a prep table next to the water heater where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Please move either the table or the insect control device. Correct as soon as possible or before, the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. The person in charge was actively preparing food and not wearing a hair restraint.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. The EHS discussed this with the person in charge.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean take out containers were being stored under the handsink behind the front counter, which is not permitted.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. Move the take out containers to a more suitable location as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the main cutting board next to the grill has three severe cracks in it, which make it no longer cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please the main cutting board as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. NANDO'S PERI-PERI CHICKEN (Inspection Date: 10/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken being held hot in the hot holding units was below 135º at 113º and 114º. Chicken wings were 125º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The PIC discarded the chicken to correct.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: several containers of mashed potatoes were not be held cold enough in the walk-in at 60º, 65º, an d 59º. According to the PIC, the potatoes were thawed under hot water and the temperature rose.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC had an employee remove potatoes from the containers and properly cool them before placing them back in container.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked whole chickens in one of the hot holding trays were not being held hot enough at 118º and 120º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The manager discarded the out of temperature chicken. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed standing water on the bottom of 2 drawers 2 DR Continental prep.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC contacted technician to complete repair.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: A review of the menu finds that the facility is producing grease in quantities likely to contribute to the production of grease-laden wastewater. Therefore, the wastewater from warewashing is required to go through a grease trap. A grease trap is missing.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. PIC will address the grease trap installation within upcoming renovation in March.
